contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual retreat. Needing meditation and silence to restore your soul's energy.

advice: You cannot keep fighting; give yourself time to gather strength.
affirmation: My mind and body have the right to rest.

title: Five of Swords
motto: Not every war is worth winning.

contextual_meanings.general: Conflict, an empty victory, hostility, and experiencing loss for the sake of pride.
contextual_meanings.love: Hurting a partner just to be right in the relationship, toxic arguments.
contextual_meanings.career: Office gossip, unfair competition, or a win-lose situation.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Ego clashes. Learning to walk away from spiritual battles that drain you.

advice: Put your ego aside; sometimes stepping back is the greatest victory.
affirmation: I prefer my own peace over being proven right.

title: Six of Swords
motto: You are moving to calmer waters.

contextual_meanings.general: Moving away from a difficult period, transition, physical or mental travel.
contextual_meanings.love: Leaving a troubled relationship behind or finding peace by overcoming problems together.
contextual_meanings.career: Transitioning to a better work environment or a change that leaves stress behind.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: A spiritual transition. Moving gracefully from turbulence to inner peace.

advice: Let go of the burdens of the past; your healing process has already begun.
affirmation: Life always carries me to better and safer places.

title: Seven of Swords
motto: Strategy, or escape?

contextual_meanings.general: Secrecy, trickery, avoidance, acting alone, and strategic intelligence.
contextual_meanings.love: Keeping secrets, suspicion of infidelity, or distancing oneself by running from problems.
contextual_meanings.career: Behind-the-scenes dealings, idea theft, or an attempt to handle a matter secretly.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual evasion. Facing the truths you have been hiding from yourself.

advice: Do not stray from honesty; the problems you run from will catch up with you one day.
affirmation: I only allow honest and pure energies into my life.

title: Eight of Swords
motto: What binds you are your own thoughts.

contextual_meanings.general: Self-imposed restrictions, victim mentality, and a feeling of helplessness.
contextual_meanings.love: Feeling trapped in a toxic relationship, unable to see a way out.
contextual_meanings.career: Hating your current job but being unable to leave due to a lack of courage.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Self-imposed spiritual exile. Realizing your limits are only illusions of the mind.

advice: Remove the blindfold; you are not as helpless as you think; there is a way out.
affirmation: I release all the boundaries created by my mind.

title: Nine of Swords
motto: Your fears grow in the dark.

contextual_meanings.general: Nightmares, excessive worry, feelings of guilt, and sleepless nights.
contextual_meanings.love: Deep anxiety about the relationship or a guilty conscience from past mistakes.
contextual_meanings.career: Immense work stress and panic caused by the fear of failure.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Dark night of the soul. Overcoming spiritual anxiety through inner light.

advice: The situation is not as bad as you make it out to be in your mind; don't hesitate to ask for help.
affirmation: I release my worries with love and sleep peacefully.

title: Ten of Swords
motto: The worst is behind you.

contextual_meanings.general: A devastating end, hitting rock bottom, being stabbed in the back, and feeling like a victim.
contextual_meanings.love: The painful and final end of a relationship, betrayal, or a massive disappointment.
contextual_meanings.career: The collapse of projects, getting fired, or extreme burnout.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Ego death. A painful but necessary ending that clears the path for rebirth.

advice: There is no further down from here. Now is the time to stand up and start over.
affirmation: I know that every ended cycle prepares me for a new and better dawn.

title: Page of Swords
motto: Keep your mind open, learn the truth.

contextual_meanings.general: Curiosity, new ideas, being alert, and quick, sharp communication.
contextual_meanings.love: Stalking on social media, a sharp-witted but sometimes tactless communication.
contextual_meanings.career: Gathering information, learning new skills, and the courage to ask tough questions.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual curiosity. Seeking truth and questioning old belief systems.

advice: Listen before you speak; your words can be as sharp as a sword.
affirmation: I seek the truth and express my opinions honestly.

title: Knight of Swords
motto: Advance rapidly toward the goal.

contextual_meanings.general: Fast, assertive, logic-driven movement. Aggressively defending your ideas.
contextual_meanings.love: Impatience in the relationship, being dominant in arguments, or a fast-developing interest.
contextual_meanings.career: Diving quickly into competition, an ambitious project presentation, or hasty decisions.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: A relentless pursuit of truth. Cutting away falsehoods with sharp logic.

advice: Weigh the consequences before acting impulsively; not everyone may be at your speed.
affirmation: I use my determination and logic for my highest good.

title: Queen of Swords
motto: See the truth with a clear mind.

contextual_meanings.general: Sharp intellect, independence, separating emotions from logic, and honesty.
contextual_meanings.love: An independent partner who demands open communication and acts with logic.
contextual_meanings.career: The ability to make objective criticisms, a fair and clear management style.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Clear spiritual discernment. Viewing your path with unbiased, higher wisdom.

advice: Remain objective without getting carried away by emotion and draw your boundaries clearly.
affirmation: Learning from my experiences, I live my own truth fearlessly.

title: King of Swords
motto: Logic and justice are your strengths.

contextual_meanings.general: Intellectual authority, analytical thinking, discipline, and fair judgment.
contextual_meanings.love: A period prioritizing mutual respect and intelligence over romance in the relationship.
contextual_meanings.career: Logic-focused leadership, achieving success in a legal/official matter.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual authority. Governing your mind and staying aligned with absolute truth.

advice: Be fair, act ethically, and do not let emotions cloud your decisions.
affirmation: My thoughts are clear, my decisions are fair.

title: Ace of Pentacles
motto: My labor is bearing fruit.

contextual_meanings.general: A new beginning in the material world, abundance, and concrete achievements.
contextual_meanings.love: A period of trust and loyalty in the relationship. Serious and concrete steps toward the future.
contextual_meanings.career: A new job offer, promotion, profitable investment, or financial security.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Grounding your spiritual energy. Finding the divine in the physical world.

advice: Turn the opportunity in front of you into a concrete plan and take practical steps.
affirmation: Abundance and prosperity flow into my life.

title: Two of Pentacles
motto: Find the balance and stay in the flow.

contextual_meanings.general: Managing multiple responsibilities, flexibility, time or money management.
contextual_meanings.love: Trying to balance work and love life, joint budget decisions.
contextual_meanings.career: Juggling between two different projects or income sources.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Balancing spiritual and earthly realms. Maintaining grace in daily life.

advice: Do not be rigid; maintain your balance by adapting to changing conditions.
affirmation: I can remain flexible through life's ups and downs.

title: Three of Pentacles
motto: Unity is strength.

contextual_meanings.general: Teamwork, mastery, appreciation of skills, and collaboration.
contextual_meanings.love: Running the relationship like a 'team', building concrete plans together.
contextual_meanings.career: Working successfully on a project, having your expertise recognized and approved.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Co-creating with the universe. Mastering your spiritual gifts through practice.

advice: Benefit from the expertise of others; you can do better together.
affirmation: I share my talents and work in harmony with my surroundings.

title: Four of Pentacles
motto: If you don't let go, you can't hold onto new things.

contextual_meanings.general: Financial security, savings, drawing boundaries, but also over-possessiveness/stinginess.
contextual_meanings.love: Jealousy towards a partner, the desire to control the relationship, or building walls.
contextual_meanings.career: Clinging tightly to a current job, avoiding risks, and hoarding resources.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual hoarding. Needing to open your heart chakra and release control.

advice: Without compromising your security, try to be a bit more generous.
affirmation: I am safe and not afraid to be generous towards life.

title: Five of Pentacles
motto: Even in the dark, there is a light.

contextual_meanings.general: Financial loss, a feeling of exclusion, temporary poverty, or isolation.
contextual_meanings.love: Going through hard times in the relationship, feeling lonely, or being excluded.
contextual_meanings.career: Job loss, financial difficulties, or feeling unsupported in the office.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual isolation. Remembering that divine help is always available if asked.

advice: Do not let pride stop you from asking for help; support is right beside you.
affirmation: Hardships are temporary; I am reconnecting to the abundance of the universe.

title: Six of Pentacles
motto: Establish the balance of giving and receiving.

contextual_meanings.general: Generosity, philanthropy, receiving or giving financial support, equality.
contextual_meanings.love: Emotional and material equality in the relationship. Mutual support.
contextual_meanings.career: Receiving an expected payment, a salary raise, or finding mentorship support.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Karmic exchange. Understanding the spiritual law of giving and receiving.

advice: If you have it, share; if you need it, do not hesitate to ask.
affirmation: I am in harmony with life's cycle of giving and receiving.

title: Seven of Pentacles
motto: The seeds you planted will grow, be patient.

contextual_meanings.general: Waiting for the results of your labor, patience, long-term investment, and evaluation.
contextual_meanings.love: Reviewing the course of the relationship, a process of being patient.
contextual_meanings.career: Waiting for investments to mature, analyzing whether a strategy is working.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual patience. Trusting the timing of your inner growth and evolution.

advice: Do not rush; allow nature to work at its own pace.
affirmation: I trust that my efforts will result in the most beautiful way.

title: Eight of Pentacles
motto: Mastery comes with attention to detail.

contextual_meanings.general: Diligence, education, mastering a new skill, and focus.
contextual_meanings.love: Putting effort into the relationship, taking practical steps to solve problems.
contextual_meanings.career: Vocational training, hard work, and steady growth in your career.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual dedication. Committing deeply to your personal soul work.

advice: Do not get distracted and keep practicing to improve your quality.
affirmation: I create my own luck with my diligence and perseverance.

title: Nine of Pentacles
motto: Enjoy luxury and independence.

contextual_meanings.general: Financial freedom, self-sufficiency, success, and harmony with nature.
contextual_meanings.love: A period where being single is golden, or having a strong, independent partner.
contextual_meanings.career: Wealth, promotion, and happily enjoying the fruits of your working life.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual independence. Enjoying the peace and abundance of an aligned soul.

advice: Celebrate your success, value yourself, and relax.
affirmation: I live in abundance and am proud of my independence.

title: Ten of Pentacles
motto: The deeper your roots, the stronger you are.

contextual_meanings.general: Lasting wealth, family legacy, traditions, security, and a solid future.
contextual_meanings.love: Families meeting, a secure partnership with deep roots that culminates in marriage.
contextual_meanings.career: Success in a family business, retirement security, or rising in an established institution.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Spiritual legacy. Realizing your deep connection to ancestors and earth wisdom.

advice: Make decisions considering future generations and lasting values.
affirmation: I honor the lasting wealth and family in my life.

title: Page of Pentacles
motto: Discover a new talent.

contextual_meanings.general: Practical steps, educational opportunities, a reliable start, and financial news.
contextual_meanings.love: A new romance potential that is reassuring, loyal, and takes concrete steps.
contextual_meanings.career: A new business plan, internship, starting an education, or finding a scholarship.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Grounded spiritual learning. Taking practical steps in your spiritual journey.

advice: Start making concrete plans to turn your dreams into reality.
affirmation: I am eager to learn and grow.

title: Knight of Pentacles
motto: Advance with slow but steady steps.

contextual_meanings.general: Reliability, routine, patient work, practicality, and stability.
contextual_meanings.love: A calm, unadventurous but extremely loyal and supportive relationship.
contextual_meanings.career: A sense of duty, steady progress, and reaching the result through disciplined work.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Steadfast spiritual practice. Committing to a daily routine of inner growth.

advice: Do not look for shortcuts; stick to your routine and get the job done.
affirmation: I walk towards my goals with determination, resolute and confident steps.

title: Queen of Pentacles
motto: Your generosity and practicality elevate you.

contextual_meanings.general: Maternal affection, practical intelligence, comfort in home life, love for nature, and abundance.
contextual_meanings.love: A warm and reliable relationship dynamic, supporting the partner in every sense.
contextual_meanings.career: Balancing work and personal life, the figure of a successful businesswoman.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Nurturing the soul. Finding spiritual comfort in nature and self-care.

advice: Take good care of yourself and your loved ones; create your comfort.
affirmation: I manage my life with love, practical intelligence, and abundance.

title: King of Pentacles
motto: You have built the empire of your labor.

contextual_meanings.general: Material success, business acumen, stability, wealth, and solid power.
contextual_meanings.love: A loyal and protective partner who offers material and spiritual security.
contextual_meanings.career: Reaching the top, an excellent financial picture, respected leadership.
contextual_meanings.spirituality: Material and spiritual mastery. Embodying divine energy in a physical form.

advice: Protect the power you have achieved and nobly enjoy your successes.
affirmation: I am successful, secure, and hold the infinite abundance of the universe.
